name: hide-comments-and-disappear
description: Hide //, ///, /* */, /*! */ comments from your code completely, while keeping #region/#endregion comment markers visible and collapsible. Toggle on/off from the status bar, command palette, or keybinding.

commands.title: Hide Comments and Disappear: Toggle Hide Comments
Hide Comments and Disappear: Enable (Hide Comments)
Hide Comments and Disappear: Disable (Show Comments)

hideCommentsAndDisappear.enabled.description: When true, comments are hidden in supported languages.

hideCommentsAndDisappear.languages.description: Language ids where comments are hidden and region folding is provided.

hideCommentsAndDisappear.hideRegionComme.description: When true, #region/#endregion comment markers are hidden too. By default they stay visible so you can collapse the region.

hideCommentsAndDisappear.collapseComment.description: When true, runs of comment-only lines are automatically collapsed while comments are hidden, so no empty lines are left behind. They expand again when hiding is turned off.
